// Source SHA256: __HASH__
import 'dart:convert';

const syncContractVersion = __VERSION__;
const syncCursorMaximum = '__MAX__';
final Map<String, dynamic> _syncSchema = jsonDecode(r'''__SCHEMA__''') as Map<String, dynamic>;

bool isSyncCursor(Object? value) {
  if (value is! String) {
    return false;
  }
  final match = RegExp(r'__PATTERN__').firstMatch(value);
  return match?.group(0) == value &&
      (value.length < syncCursorMaximum.length ||
       (value.length == syncCursorMaximum.length && value.compareTo(syncCursorMaximum) <= 0));
}

String syncCursor(Object? value) {
  if (!isSyncCursor(value)) {
    throw const FormatException('Invalid sync int64 cursor');
  }
  return value as String;
}

// Validator for the schema subset used here. The generator FAILS on unknown
// keywords; extending the schema requires extending this validator and tests.
void validateSync(String definition, Object? value) {
  final definitions = _syncSchema['definitions'] as Map<String, dynamic>;
  if (!definitions.containsKey(definition)) {
    throw ArgumentError(definition);
  }
  _validate(definitions[definition] as Map<String, dynamic>, value, definition);
}

bool _typeMatches(String type, Object? value) {
  switch (type) {
    case 'null': return value == null;
    case 'string': return value is String;
    case 'integer': return value is int || (value is double && value.isFinite && value == value.truncateToDouble());
    case 'object': return value is Map<String, dynamic>;
    case 'array': return value is List;
    default: throw StateError('Unsupported schema type: $type');
  }
}

void _validate(Map<String, dynamic> schema, Object? value, String path) {
  Never invalid() => throw FormatException('Invalid sync value at $path');
  if (schema.containsKey(r'$ref')) {
    final name = (schema[r'$ref'] as String).split('/').last;
    _validate((_syncSchema['definitions'] as Map<String, dynamic>)[name] as Map<String, dynamic>, value, path);
    return;
  }
  final type = schema['type'];
  final types = type is List ? type : [if (type != null) type];
  if (types.isNotEmpty && !types.any((t) => _typeMatches(t as String, value))) {
    invalid();
  }
  if (schema.containsKey('enum') && !(schema['enum'] as List).contains(value)) {
    invalid();
  }
  if (value is String) {
    final length = value.runes.length;
    if (schema.containsKey('minLength') && length < (schema['minLength'] as int)) {
      invalid();
    }
    if (schema.containsKey('maxLength') && length > (schema['maxLength'] as int)) {
      invalid();
    }
    if (schema.containsKey('pattern') && !RegExp(schema['pattern'] as String).hasMatch(value)) {
      invalid();
    }
    if (schema['format'] == 'sync-cursor' && !isSyncCursor(value)) {
      invalid();
    }
    if (schema['format'] == 'uuid' &&
        !RegExp(r'^(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$', caseSensitive: false).hasMatch(value)) invalid();
  }
  if (value is num && schema.containsKey('minimum') && value < (schema['minimum'] as num)) {
    invalid();
  }
  if (value is List && schema.containsKey('items')) {
    for (var i = 0; i < value.length; i++) {
      _validate(schema['items'] as Map<String, dynamic>, value[i], '$path[$i]');
    }
  }
  if (value is Map<String, dynamic>) {
    for (final key in (schema['required'] as List? ?? [])) {
      if (!value.containsKey(key)) {
        invalid();
      }
    }
    final properties = schema['properties'] as Map<String, dynamic>? ?? {};
    for (final key in value.keys) {
      if (properties.containsKey(key)) {
        _validate(properties[key] as Map<String, dynamic>, value[key], '$path.$key');
      } else if (schema['additionalProperties'] == false) {
        invalid();
      }
    }
  }
}

// Auth/refresh/session storage belong to the transport adapter, not this codec.
// Transport must THROW on non-2xx (400/401/403 must never look like success).
// No implicit retry of POST /devices: registration isn't idempotent yet.
typedef SyncTransport = Future<Map<String, dynamic>> Function(
    String method, String path, Map<String, dynamic> data);

class SyncWireClient {
  SyncWireClient(this._transport);
  final SyncTransport _transport;

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> _request(String method, String path,
      String requestDefinition, String responseDefinition, Map<String, dynamic> data) async {
    validateSync(requestDefinition, data);
    final response = await _transport(method, path, data);
    validateSync(responseDefinition, response);
    return response;
  }
__METHODS__
}
